versions.content: Traffic class specific enabling of egress frame preemption The attribute CouplingPortFifo.trafficClassPreemptionSupport defines whether frames handled by this CouplingPortFifo shall be • EthernetCouplingPortPreemptionEnum.preemptable or have the setting • EthernetCouplingPortPreemptionEnum.express, which makes then non preemptable according to IEEE Std 802.1Q-2022 [15].
